neutral.selection: skip if rand()%100+1 <= signed_profile_byte20; otherwise continue

opposite.selection: skip on seasonal rejection, else apply the neutral focus gate

primary_entry_rule: Entry initializes current product directly from profile+8. The in-store seasonal/focus gate is bypassed while that product is already assigned.
arrival_rule: Unless bypass flag is set: reject when profile+13+20 < weather; seasonal gate primary product and reject only return2; then apply selected weekday/holiday share roll.
cash_rule: No ordinary profile product slot references26. Cash is excluded from the store price-average accumulator. Customer withdrawal/fees are not established.
rng_rule: LCG seed=(seed*1103515245+12345)&0xffffffff; rand=(seed>>16)&32767. Preserve conditional call order and modulo100.
